title: Should You <g>Automate</g>
This Task?
subtitle: Four questions. Every no saves you a mess.

cards.title: Does it happen every week?
cards.body: One-offs cost more to automate than to do.

cards.title: Is it done the same way each time?
cards.body: Two people, two ways means it is not ready.

cards.title: Is it safe if it goes wrong?
cards.body: No money and no client name on the line.
cards.no: Keep your yes on every send

cards.title: Can it run on tools you already have?
cards.body: The simplest thing that does the job wins.
